# ADR-0037 — S1.5a cross-posted projects contract

## Status
Proposed

## Date
2026-09-11

## Slice
S1.5a

## Context
Kind: deviation
- Spec says: `docs/build/04-server-contracts.md` §0 SC-16 env row (`CURSEFORGE_API_KEY` … "`setProjectLink` → `upstream_error`"), §1.0 (`setProjectLink` row + the Role-rule paragraph), §1.4 `setProjectLink` (`platform: z.literal('curseforge')`; refuses `source='odsens'` rows; `ref: null` removes), `uploadProjectMedia` Effects ("`icon`: `source='odsens'` only; modrinth rows → `forbidden`"), `uploadProjectFile` Auth ("Only `source='odsens'` projects (`forbidden` otherwise)") + begin ("`version_id` = existing `project_versions (project_id, version_number)`") + Effects ("Upsert `project_versions` (external_id null)"; "if `primary` true → clear `primary` on siblings; if version has no primary → this file becomes primary"; "filename unique within version (`conflict`)"), `publishProject` Preconditions ("`source='odsens'`"), `curateProject` Input ("every `extra_gallery.path` must match `^project-media/<this project_id>/gallery/…`"), `createExclusiveProject` Effects ("slug conflict (citext, incl. synced → Modrinth 'Download on Modrinth'"), "Not found" (unknown slug → `notFound()`), §5 (`setProjectLink` row); `docs/build/03-components.md` §2.2 `ExclusiveBadge` ("Never rendered when `project.source !== 'odsens'`"), §2.3 `GetItPanel` (rows), `VersionsTable` (`source` prop drives the analytics source), `FeaturedHero` (`downloadKind`); `docs/build/05-test-plan.md` §8 row S1.5a ("IDs assigned at Session A"), T-ACT-37/38/39 (synced rows → `forbidden`), T-ACT-41 (`setProjectLink`), T-UNIT-30 (`primaryFirst`), T-UNIT-36 (`isExclusive`); `docs/build/00-build-plan.md` §S1.2 (four `setProjectLink` mentions), §S1.5a (the items it leaves to "the slice ADR": action names, the fold's old-slug mechanism, the `Downloadable` generalisation), §4.2 ("none new unless the slice ADR adds `project_redirects`").
- Found: 00 §S1.5a (inserted by ADR-0036 from David's 2026-09-11 calls — `docs/questions.md` "Cross-posting decision") needs the frozen letter of 01/02/03/04/data-model changed before it can be built: the link action shape, where a linked listing's versions go, what happens to a duplicate the sync already imported, uploads on synced rows, the download panel's primary, the badge predicate, and how a folded slug keeps resolving. A pre-build adversarial review of the first draft (three lenses, 2026-09-11) found the constraints the letter must respect: `project_versions_external_id_key` is a plain non-deferrable unique, so a merge must delete the duplicate version row before the canonical row takes its id; the primary cross-posting case (Oliver posts `foo` on odsens, then submits `foo` to Modrinth) would make the hourly sync's insert fail on `projects.slug` every hour; a link written after a fold that then fails would let the next sync re-create the duplicate and pull the merged hosted versions onto it; adoption must apply to Modrinth-first rows too (a hosted version uploaded before Modrinth lists the same number); counters on a folded row are not re-derivable; the detail page's `generateMetadata` runs before the page body. Each decision below is the smallest change that makes the model "one project, many homes" true end to end and convergent under the hourly sync from any state.
- Related: ADR-0036 (the slice), ADR-0026 (version identity — `external_id` is the adoption key), ADR-0027 (two-phase uploads; D5 deferred the `Downloadable` generalisation), ADR-0025 (streamed 404 on ISR routes — the redirect assertion shape), ADR-0002 #42 (CDN downloads — now the fallback for CDN-only rows), ADR-0030 D8 (fixture-server route extension precedent), ADR-0034 D1 (synced slugs are normalised — the Modrinth page URL therefore comes from the id, not our slug; `p-<id>` is the last-resort slug), `docs/questions.md` 2026-09-11 "Cross-posting decision".

## Decision
1. **Link actions replace `setProjectLink`.** `lib/actions/projects.ts` exports `linkProjectListing` and `unlinkProjectListing` (admin-only, `requireRole('admin')`; both `assertRateLimit('project_link', profile_id, 30, '1 hour')`; SC-24 audit line). Inputs (`lib/actions/projects.schema.ts`): `linkProjectListingInput = {project_id: uuid, platform: z.enum(['modrinth','curseforge']), ref: string 1..300}`, `unlinkProjectListingInput = {project_id: uuid, platform}`. `setProjectLink` is retired (registry rename; T-ACT-41 keeps its number and becomes the `curseforge` case of `linkProjectListing`; its `ref:null` clause moves to T-ACT-80). The `curseforge` case keeps every `setProjectLink` rule (digits or CurseForge URL via `parseRef`; `getMod` / `searchBySlug`; `CURSEFORGE_API_KEY` unset → `upstream_error` "CurseForge key not configured"; the link row + `projects.downloads_curseforge` set immediately) **minus** the "`source='odsens'` → `validation`" refusal — an exclusive may now gain a CurseForge link and loses its badge by design (David, 2026-09-11). The `modrinth` case: `ref` is a Modrinth URL (`https://(www.)?modrinth.com/(mod|plugin|datapack|resourcepack|shader|modpack|project)/<slug-or-id>[/…]`), a bare slug or a bare id (`/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$/`), parsed by the pure adapter export `parseModrinthRef(ref) → {ref} | null` (any other host → `validation`); resolution is `adapters/modrinth.getProject(idOrSlug)` → `GET /v2/project/{id|slug}` (SC-09; 404 → `not_found` "Nothing on Modrinth matches that."; other upstream failure → `upstream_error`). Preconditions, checked before any write: the project exists (`not_found`); `projects.source = 'odsens'` — a `source='modrinth'` row IS its listing (`validation` "This project is synced from Modrinth already."); this project has no `modrinth` link to a *different* listing (`conflict` "Remove the current Modrinth listing first." — replacing a listing must go through unlink so the un-adopt runs; re-linking the same id is idempotent); the listing is not linked to another project (`conflict` "That listing is already linked to <title>." — the new unique index `project_links_platform_external_id_key (platform, external_id)` is the atomic backstop: a 23505 on the upsert maps to this `conflict`). Effects, **in this order** (the link is written first so a fold failure leaves a state the sync converges from — Decision 2 (i) routes the listing into this project, step 4 hides the stale duplicate, re-linking re-runs the fold): (a) upsert `project_links {project_id, platform:'modrinth', external_id: raw.id, url: modrinthListingUrl(raw.id), downloads: raw.downloads, synced_at: now()}` (PK `(project_id, platform)`); (b) `projects.downloads_modrinth = raw.downloads` immediately (the T-ACT-41 precedent); (c) if a `projects` row `(source='modrinth', external_id = raw.id)` exists → RPC `fold_project(duplicate, this)` (Decision 3); (d) `revalidateTag('projects')`, `revalidateTag('project:<slug>')`, and when (c) ran also `revalidateTag('project:<redirect_slug>')` (the RPC's return value — the renamed-slug precedent). Versions arrive on the next `syncModrinth` run (hourly, or "Sync now") — the action never calls the job and never calls `listVersions`. `unlinkProjectListing`: for `modrinth`, **un-adopt first**, then delete the link row, then `downloads_modrinth = 0`; un-adopt = every `project_versions` row on this project with `external_id IS NOT NULL` (an odsens row holds at most one `modrinth` link — PK `(project_id, platform)` — and CurseForge has no version rows) **that carries ≥ 1 hosted file** (`project_files.storage_path IS NOT NULL`) gets `external_id = NULL`, at most one row per `version_number` (the row holding a hosted `primary` file, else the newest `date_published`; any other same-numbered adopted row keeps its `external_id` — `project_versions_exclusive_version_key` is a partial unique); rows with no hosted file keep their `external_id` and follow the listing on the next sync (Decision 2). CDN-only file rows on un-adopted versions are kept (nothing but the fold deletes a synced row) and are not rendered while the project has no platform home (Decision 6). For `curseforge`: delete the row, `downloads_curseforge = 0`. Both cases revalidate `projects` + `project:<slug>`. Errors: `forbidden`, `not_found`, `validation`, `conflict`, `upstream_error`, `rate_limited`. Returns `{ok:true, data:{link}}` / `{ok:true, data:{link: null}}`.
2. **Sync adoption (`syncModrinth`, 04 §3.1 steps 2–4).** For each listed Modrinth project X the job resolves **the target row X syncs into**: (i) a `project_links` row `{platform:'modrinth', external_id: X.id}` → its `project_id` (the canonical odsens row — "linked"); else (ii) the `projects` row `(source='modrinth', external_id = X.id)` (update) or a new one (insert) — today's step 2. **Step 2 for a linked X never inserts or updates a `projects` row's metadata**: the odsens row's title, description, body, icon, gallery, categories, loaders, game versions, license, links and status are Oliver's; the job writes only `project_links.downloads/url/synced_at` and `projects.downloads_modrinth` (J-I compare; the canonical row's `synced_at` is untouched). **Step 2 (ii) slug collision**: the job resolves the effective slug before its compare — the mapped slug (`normalizeSyncedSlug`, ADR-0034 D1) unless another row that is not this listing's own holds it (the primary cross-posting case: Oliver's odsens `foo` exists when Modrinth approves `foo`), in which case the stored slug is kept on update and the ADR-0034 last-resort slug `p-<id lower>` is used on insert; no error is counted. The `/admin/projects` match note (Decision 8) keys on the title as well as the slug so the suggestion still surfaces. **A hosted icon wins on any row**: step 2 leaves `icon_url` alone when the stored value is a Storage path (`project-media/…`), so an icon Oliver uploaded onto a Modrinth-first project survives every sync. **Step 3 keys versions on `external_id` globally** (not per project): a matching row on another project is re-parented (`project_id` = the target — a version row follows its listing; this is what makes unlink and any stray state converge) and then treated as existing; no match → **on the target row (linked canonical or the Modrinth-first row itself)** a version with `external_id IS NULL AND version_number = V.version_number` **adopts** the Modrinth id (`external_id = V.id`) and from then on is sync-owned (`name, changelog_md, game_versions, loaders, version_type, date_published, downloads` follow Modrinth on every run; its hosted files stay); among same-numbered upstream candidates (ADR-0026 duplicates) the one carrying a file whose `sha512` equals a file of that hosted version adopts, else the first in adapter order; otherwise insert. **Files:** the `(version_id, filename)` match applies only to CDN-only rows (`storage_path IS NULL`); before inserting an upstream file the job checks `sha512` against every file of the version — a match means the same bytes live in both homes: no new row, and the matching row gains `url` (the CDN URL) when it had none (the ADR-0002 #42 CDN link, recorded on the row); a hosted row with the same filename but a different `sha512` is left alone and the upstream file lands as its own CDN row. `primary` is scoped per home: the job writes it on CDN-only rows only; `uploadProjectFile` manages it among hosted rows only. **Step 4** hides (never deletes) a `source='modrinth'` row when its `external_id` is absent from the list **or** a `project_links {platform:'modrinth', external_id}` row points at a different project (a duplicate the fold normally prevents) — both computed from the list and the links, never from per-item success (J-P keeps a row that failed mid-item). **Revalidate:** a linked X revalidates `project:<canonical slug>` (never its Modrinth slug) plus the slug of any project a version was re-parented from; a linked X counts in `items` only when a link, count, version or file row changed. The idempotency keys are unchanged (`projects (source, external_id)`, `project_versions.external_id`, `project_files (version_id, filename)` for CDN-only rows); a run with unchanged upstream data still changes no row but `synced_at`. `syncCurseforge` is unchanged (counts only, ADR-0036).
3. **The fold — RPC `fold_project(p_duplicate_id uuid, p_canonical_id uuid) returns jsonb`** (`security definer`, `set search_path = public`, `volatile`; one transaction; plpgsql; grants verbatim: `revoke all on function public.fold_project(uuid, uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role; grant execute on function public.fold_project(uuid, uuid) to service_role;`). Preconditions (raise `P0002`-class errors with a plain message, nothing written): both rows exist and differ; the duplicate is `source='modrinth'`; the canonical is `source='odsens'`. Steps, in this order: (a) **merge** — for each duplicate version whose `version_number` equals a canonical version with `external_id IS NULL` (whether the duplicate version is synced or itself hosted — Decision 5 lets a Modrinth-first row carry hosted versions): save the duplicate version's `external_id` and sync-owned columns → move its files onto the canonical version, except a **CDN-only** duplicate file (`storage_path IS NULL`) whose `sha512` equals a canonical file's, which is dropped after the matching canonical row gains its `url` when null (hosted duplicate rows are always moved, never deleted — their `download_count`, `project_downloads` rows and Storage objects stay; a moved hosted row keeps its `storage_path`, the object is not moved) → `delete` the duplicate version row → `update` the canonical row with the saved `external_id` (when not null) and sync-owned columns (this order is forced by the non-deferrable `project_versions_external_id_key`; the duplicate's `external_id` is never nulled first — that would hit `project_versions_exclusive_version_key` on the duplicate); (b) every other duplicate version → `project_id = canonical`; `primary` after a move: a moved hosted row keeps `primary` only when the canonical version has no hosted `primary` yet, a moved CDN row only when it has no CDN `primary` (canonical wins); (c) `project_links` of the duplicate → re-parented unless the canonical already has that platform (then the duplicate's row is dropped — canonical wins); a re-parented `curseforge` link sets `canonical.downloads_curseforge = link.downloads`; (d) `comments where target_type='project' and target_id = duplicate` → `target_id = canonical` (likes/reports ride the comment ids; `comments_guard()` passes service-role writes); (e) `project_downloads.project_id` → canonical and `canonical.downloads_direct += duplicate.downloads_direct` (the counter is not re-derivable — the log is purged after 90 days); (f) `project_overrides`: no canonical row → the duplicate's row is re-keyed; else merged column-wise — the canonical value wins wherever it is non-default, `extra_gallery` entries are appended verbatim (their objects stay under the duplicate's folder; Decision 5(e)); (g) `project_redirects (old_slug → canonical id)` inserted (`on conflict (old_slug) do update set project_id`); (h) the duplicate `projects` row is deleted (its children were moved; the FK cascade removes nothing else). Returns `{versions_moved, versions_merged, files_moved, files_deduped, comments_moved, downloads_moved, downloads_direct_moved, links_moved, redirect_slug}`. **This is the one recorded exception to 01 INV-24 / 04 J-D "never delete synced rows"**: it deletes exactly one synced `projects` row, the duplicate `project_versions` rows merged into a canonical version, and CDN-only sha512-duplicate `project_files` rows — only when an admin links a listing the sync had already imported; it is an action-invoked RPC, not a job, so INV-24's `lib/jobs` grep is unchanged. Idempotent from the action's side: "no duplicate row" means nothing to fold; a second call naming a deleted duplicate raises and the action never issues it.
4. **Old slugs keep resolving: table `project_redirects (old_slug citext primary key, project_id uuid not null references projects(id) on delete cascade, created_at timestamptz not null default now())`** + index `project_redirects_project_id_idx (project_id)` (ADR-0030 D11 precedent); grants verbatim `revoke all on table public.project_redirects from public, anon, authenticated, service_role; grant select on table public.project_redirects to anon, authenticated; grant all on table public.project_redirects to service_role;`; RLS on with one policy `project_redirects_select_visible_or_admin for select to anon, authenticated using (public.project_is_visible(project_id) or public.is_admin())` and no JWT write policy (the fold writes). `lib/data/projects.ts` gains `resolveProjectPage(slug) → {kind:'detail', detail} | {kind:'redirect', slug} | null` (anon client; the redirect read is cached under `projects` + `project:<old slug>`); **both** `generateMetadata` and the page component of `/projects/[slug]` call it and issue `permanentRedirect('/projects/<canonical slug>')` before any `notFound()` (`generateMetadata` runs first — a redirect placed only in the page body would never fire). A live `projects.slug` always wins over a redirect row (projects are read first). `createExclusiveProject` / `updateExclusiveProject` refuse a slug present in `project_redirects` → `conflict` (the taken-slug message). Redirect rows never appear in the sitemap. Under ADR-0025 the streamed ISR route may answer 200 + a client redirect instead of a 308, so tests assert the landing URL (status ∈ {308, 200}).
5. **Uploads for every source (04 §1.4).** (a) `uploadProjectMedia` `kind='icon'` on a `source='modrinth'` row sets `projects.icon_url = path` — the sync keeps it (Decision 2); `gallery` on a synced row stays `project_overrides.extra_gallery` (ADR-0002 C10). (b) `uploadProjectFile` accepts every `source`. `begin`: `version_id` = the existing version with that `version_number` on this project — a row with `external_id IS NULL` first, else the newest synced row with that number (ADR-0026 allows duplicates) — or a fresh uuid. `commit`, sibling rules over the version's files: a **CDN-only sibling with the same `sha512`** (`storage_path IS NULL`) gains `storage_path = path` (it becomes the hosted row and keeps `url` — the mirror of Decision 2's "hosted row gains `url`"; both upload orders converge on one row) and the hosted `primary` rule applies to it; a **hosted sibling with the same filename and the same `sha512`** → the existing row (U3, unchanged); a hosted sibling with the same filename and different bytes → `conflict` (04's "filename unique within version" now considers hosted rows only — a CDN-only row may share a filename, Decision 2); otherwise a new hosted row. The `primary` flag is scoped to hosted siblings — "clear `primary` on siblings" and "no primary yet" consider rows with `storage_path IS NOT NULL` only. On a hosted version row (`external_id IS NULL`) the version metadata upserts as today; on a synced version row the form's version metadata is **ignored** (the row follows Modrinth) and only the file row is written. (c) `publishProject` accepts every `source` (the preconditions apply unchanged — icon + ≥ 1 hosted file to reach `published`); for synced rows the durable hide remains `project_overrides.hidden` (the sync re-asserts `status='published'` for listed rows), so the editor offers publish controls on `source='odsens'` rows only. (d) `lib/files.ts resolveDownloadable(id)` serves any `project_files` row with `storage_path` on a published, non-hidden project regardless of `source` (the S1.3 code already had no source check; the contract now says so); RPC `record_download` counts `downloads_direct` on any project. The `Downloadable` shape is unchanged (ADR-0027 D5 stays deferred to S1.7 — kind `skin`). (e) `curateProject`: an `extra_gallery` entry whose `path` is already present in the stored `project_overrides.extra_gallery` skips the `<this project_id>` folder check (it was validated when added; a folded duplicate's entries live under the old folder); the bucket HEAD check still runs for every entry; new entries are pattern-checked as before.
6. **Primary download rule (read model, `lib/data/projects.ts`; `lib/versions.ts`; 02 §2.1 #1, §2.3 rail; 03 `GetItPanel` / `FeaturedHero` / `VersionsTable` / `DetailsList`).** Per file: `storage_path IS NOT NULL` → `/api/download/<file id>` (kind `direct`); else `url` (kind `modrinth`; the project's Modrinth page when `url` is null — data guard). `lib/versions.ts` exports `hostedFirst(files)` — hosted primary → hosted → CDN primary → CDN — which **replaces `primaryFirst`** (`sortVersionsForTable` uses it; T-UNIT-30 amended) — and `selectPrimaryFile(versions)`: **the hosted primary file of the newest version that has a hosted file** (David: the hosted file is always the primary; an older hosted release beats a newer CDN-only one, which the versions table still lists); none → the project's Modrinth home when it has one (`source='modrinth'`, or a `modrinth` link) → the Modrinth project page ("Download on Modrinth", kind `modrinth`, the newest version's CDN file meta shown — today's rule verbatim); no home and no hosted file → no panel (the S1.3 degrade; unreachable for a published odsens row, whose publish precondition needs a hosted file). The hero DOWNLOAD follows the same rule (`downloadKind` `direct`/`modrinth`). **CDN-only file rows are not rendered on a project with no platform home** (`is_exclusive` — Decision 7): an unlinked odsens project lists hosted files only, so the badge stays a true statement after an unlink; the rows come back when the project is linked again. **"Also on" rows** come from `project_links` **or** `source`: a `source='modrinth'` row → Modrinth (href = `modrinthListingUrl(external_id)` — the id, not our normalised slug, ADR-0034 D1; count `downloads_modrinth`); a `project_links` row → its `url` + count (`modrinth` rows `downloads_modrinth`, `curseforge` rows `downloads_curseforge`, so the rows still sum to `downloads_total` — S1.5a.AC6). The row word is "Also on Modrinth" / "Also on CurseForge" when the primary is `direct`, and the bare platform word when the primary is the Modrinth page (today's look — no "also" under "Download on Modrinth"); the direct row and the combined-count line are unchanged. `VersionsTable`: `files[].kind: 'direct' | 'modrinth'` (additive) drives each row's href and the `TrackedLink` `source` value; the `source` prop is dropped (fixture `tests/fixtures/ui/versionsTable.ts` amended). `DetailsList` Source: `source='modrinth'` → "Modrinth" link; `odsens` with no link → "Only on odsens"; `odsens` with a link → "odsens". `lib/data/projects.ts modrinthProjectUrl(slug)` is removed; Modrinth page URLs come from `modrinthListingUrl(id)` (`lib/format/project.ts`, pure) only.
7. **`is_exclusive` (03 `ExclusiveBadge` rule; 02 §2.1/§2.3).** `projects_public` gains the trailing column `is_exclusive boolean = (p.source = 'odsens' and not exists (select 1 from project_links l where l.project_id = p.id))` (`create or replace view`; the WHERE clause still gates the row before the boolean is computed, so nothing about hidden projects leaks); cards, hero and detail read it (list reads no longer infer from `source` alone). `lib/data/projects.ts isExclusive(source, links)` keeps the same predicate for unit parity (T-UNIT-36 amended to say so). The badge renders only while `is_exclusive`; linking removes it everywhere at the action's revalidate; unlinking brings it back (00 S1.5a.AC5).
8. **Admin editor + list (02 §1.3; 03 §2.10; `lib/data/admin.ts`).** `getAdminProject` gains `externalId` and `modrinthLink: {externalId, url, downloads} | null` (one `project_links` read for both platforms); `listAdminProjects` gains `externalId`. `/admin/projects/[id]`: a "Modrinth listing" `Field` (label "Modrinth listing (URL, slug or id)") beside "CurseForge id or URL"; **both fields share one recipe** — a Link `Button` (`linkProjectListing({platform})`) and, when linked, the link's URL + `formatCount(downloads)` with a Remove `Button` (`unlinkProjectListing({platform})`); the CurseForge helper drops "Empty removes the link"; the Modrinth helper reads "Versions arrive on the next sync."; on `source='modrinth'` rows the Modrinth field is read-only showing `modrinthListingUrl(external_id)` with helper "Synced from Modrinth — this is the project's home listing." and no buttons, while the CurseForge field keeps its controls. Errors surface on the field via the page's PRG `?form=link…` mechanism. The icon / gallery / `ProjectFileWell` upload wells render on synced rows too (the synced branch keeps its curate panel); moderators see field, buttons and wells disabled (`disabled` + `title="Admin only"`), never hidden (03 §2.10). `/admin/projects`: under a `source='modrinth'` row's name, when an `odsens` row shares its `projectMatchKey` (lower-case alphanumerics of the slug **or** the title; `lib/format/project.ts`, pure) → "Looks like the same project as <title> — link it" as a ghost link to `/admin/projects/<odsens id>?listing=<modrinth external_id>`, which prefills the Modrinth field; nothing links automatically. `?listing=` is read on the dynamic admin route only (02 §0.1; RP-03 restricts public pages).
9. **Schema (supabase-ops).** Migrations, one concern each: `20260911120000_project_links_unique_listing.sql` (unique index `project_links_platform_external_id_key (platform, external_id)`), `20260911120100_project_redirects.sql` (table + index + grants + RLS per Decision 4), `20260911120200_projects_public_is_exclusive.sql` (`create or replace view` adding `is_exclusive` last, grants re-stated), `20260911120300_fold_project.sql` (the RPC + the every-role revoke/grant of Decision 3). `lib/supabase/types.ts` regenerated. RLS on `project_links` unchanged (select via `project_is_visible()` or admin; writes admin/service). `scripts/wait-for-schema.mjs` needs nothing (it parses `create table` and polls `migration_versions()`).
10. **Adapter + fixtures (`lib/adapters/modrinth.ts`; fixture servers).** `getProject(idOrSlug)` → `GET /project/{id|slug}` (SC-09); pure exports `parseModrinthRef(ref)`; `modrinthListingUrl(id)` (= `https://modrinth.com/project/<id>`) lives in `lib/format/project.ts` (the adapter imports it). Fixtures: `tests/fixtures/modrinth/project/sd000101.json` (the `sd000101` object of `user-projects.json`, byte-equal — an alias) and `tests/fixtures/modrinth/project/sd000199.json` (hand-made from the same shape: id `sd000199`, slug `e2e-cross-post`, title `E2E Cross Post`, a listing absent from the 18-project list so no sync run ever imports it; no `.meta.json`, like the S1.5 discord/resend shapes). ## Alternatives considered
| Alternative | Why not |
|---|---|
| Keep `setProjectLink` and add a separate `linkModrinthListing` | Two mechanisms for one idea; David asked for one (2026-09-11). Retiring the name is a registry rename → this ADR. |
| Sync versions into the canonical project from the link action itself | Couples an action to the job's lock + `sync_runs` semantics; the hourly run (or "Sync now") already converges within the hour. |
| Fold first, then write the link | A link failure after the fold leaves the duplicate deleted and the listing unlinked; the next sync re-creates the duplicate and pulls the merged hosted versions onto it. Link first: a fold failure leaves a state Decision 2 converges from. |
| Unlink deletes the adopted versions / their CDN rows | Deleting synced rows outside the fold breaks the rule the slice was asked to keep narrow; un-adopt + "a version row follows its listing" + hiding CDN-only rows while exclusive converges without a delete. |
| Silently replace an existing Modrinth link with a new listing | The un-adopt would be skipped and the next sync would carry Oliver's hosted versions to the old listing's re-created row; `conflict` "Remove the current listing first" is one rule, one code path. |
| Fail the hourly sync on a slug collision (today's behaviour) | The primary cross-posting case — the same slug on both sites — would error every hour and never surface the match note. |
| No `project_redirects` — rely on revalidation | Nothing maps the folded slug to the canonical page once the row is gone; a 404 on a URL Modrinth users may hold is the thing the fold must not cause. |
| Overwrite the canonical odsens row's metadata from the listing | The odsens row is canonical by David's decision; Oliver's copy, icon and gallery must not be replaced hourly. |
| Primary = the newest version's file whatever its home | Contradicts "the hosted file is always the primary download"; an older hosted release beats a newer CDN-only one, and the versions table still lists the newer one. |
| An `icon_override` column instead of "a Storage path wins" | A second column for one value; the path shape already says which home the icon lives in. |

## Consequences
- Positive: one canonical row per project; hosted files are the primary download on every source; the badge is a true statement; the sync converges from any state (link, unlink, stale duplicate, failed fold, slug collision) without deleting synced rows; folded URLs keep working; counters survive a fold.
- Negative: `unlinkProjectListing` leaves CDN-only file rows (hidden while exclusive) on un-adopted hosted versions; `extra_gallery` objects and hosted file objects of a folded duplicate stay under the old folder; the versions table may show two same-named files when Oliver uploaded a different build under the same name; a slug collision gives a synced row the `p-<id>` slug until it is folded.
- Follow-ups: S1.7 still implements ADR-0027 D5 (`Downloadable` kind `skin`) → `backend-robustness`; the `ship` skill's tag line already knows `v0.6.1` (ADR-0036).
